decision_logic.reason: No verified hard gate established a material 180s failure, but the frozen direct-evidence requirements for a supported mainnet-grade claim are not met.

supported_findings: The exact active-v4 180s DAA converged under the frozen honest 0.1x–10x hash-rate shocks without floor/ceiling lock.
The active 180s package improves block/reward event frequency and reduces payout-count variance relative to 300s/600s at equal miner share.
Sub-second propagation reported in failed historical 180s soaks is directionally encouraging but is not promoted to PASS.
No relative miner block-share advantage from the tested +120s timestamp strategies was demonstrated in the paired model.
warnings: The active integer-bit DAA is coarse: the stationary deterministic target envelope implied by nearest-bit quantization spans approximately 127.3s–254.6s around a nominal 180s target.
The 256-seed stable-hash model produced a median per-seed mean interval of about 191.6s and repeated retarget-bit changes.
The active +120s timestamp rule measurably couples into DAA cadence even though a relative reward-share advantage was not demonstrated.
180s amplifies fixed propagation-latency advantage and fixed-outage competing-block exposure relative to 300s/600s.
Very small solo miners still experience material payout lumpiness even though 180s reduces it relative to longer targets.
missing_required_evidence: Fresh directly comparable 180s WAN/physical raw evidence with provenance.
At least 500 admitted 180s propagation samples with P50/mean/P95 and P99 when the raw distribution permits.
Natural stale/fork/reorg denominators sufficient to satisfy the frozen Wilson 95% confidence gates.
Fresh recovery/partition evidence against a precommitted recovery bound with deterministic state convergence.
Repository-resident authoritative raw provenance for the historical V1/V2 stability-soak result bundles, or a fresh superseding dataset.
preserved_failures: Stability Soak V1 remains FAIL; pre-failure healthy observations are not a partial PASS.
Stability Soak V2 remains FAIL; the reported ~208s divergence exceeded its frozen 180s gate.
The failed CI runs created while binding later frontiers remain failed historical executions and were superseded only by new successful runs.
interpretation: 180s was not falsified by the completed software-only evidence, but it is not sufficiently supported by the currently admitted evidence for a mainnet-grade block-time claim.
reopen_condition: Reopen this research verdict when fresh directly comparable 180s WAN/physical/natural-event evidence satisfying the frozen admission gates is available. A future Stability Soak V3 result may be admitted only as a separate, explicitly classified evidence source.
